skills.name: resolve_family_office
skills.description: Resolve an identifier (LEI, legal name, alias or register id) to the family-office records that carry it, with the node that serves each.

skills.name: get_record
skills.description: The Family Office Record for one identifier: identity, registrations, lei, principals, sectors, website, aliases, events, gaps — every field with value, source_url, read_by, read and state; optionally a named version.

skills.name: list_events_since
skills.description: Dated, URL'd events on one record, oldest first, optionally since a date, paged by cursor.

skills.name: list_aliases
skills.description: Every name the record carries for one identifier, each with its source.

skills.name: list_nodes
skills.description: The graph's nodes with record counts read from each node's index, the node door and its as-of.
